wiki.title: Luke Evslin
wiki.extract: Luke Alexander Evslin (born 1984) is an American politician serving in the Hawaii House of Representatives for the 16th district (Wailua, Hanamā‘ulu, Kapaia, Līhu‘e, Puhi, portion of ‘Ōma‘o). He was appointed by Governor Josh Green in 2023 to replace James Tokioka and serve out the rest of his term.
